senses.gloss: f. (סְבָא; v. סַבּוֹיָתָא) keeper of a wine shop.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 70b:4">Ab. Zar. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>ההיא מ׳ דמסרה לאקלידא לגויה</he> Ms. M. (ed. incorr.) a shopkeeper who gave her key in charge of a gentile woman.—[<cite ref="Shabbat 105b">Sabb. 105ᵇ</cite> Alf. Ms. <he>מס׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02277"><he>מְצוּבִיתָא</he></cite>.
